items.title: Purchase order number required on company reservations
items.summary: Properties can mark a company as requiring a PO number; reservations for it can't be created without one. Group bookings share one number; availability-block reservations are prefilled.
items.pitch: A guardrail for corporate business: ask for the PO up front instead of discovering it missing when the invoice bounces.
items.segmentation: Tier 3. All users; off by default, per company.

items.title: See every scheduled export and its owner
items.summary: Admins with Manage property settings can see, edit and bulk-delete all scheduled exports, with a new Owner column and filter.
items.segmentation: Tier 3. All users; full visibility only for admins with Manage property settings.

items.title: Tips report in Mews POS
items.summary: One report for tips, service charges and tip-pool contributions by date, outlet, employee and transaction; exports to CSV/Excel/PDF. Staff see own tips in the POS Android app.
items.pitch: Replaces stitching tip data together before payroll; supports tipping setups needed in North America.
items.segmentation: Tier 2. Properties with tipping enabled on at least one outlet.

items.title: POS North America expansion: multi-tax and net pricing
items.summary: Release note for POS NA Expansion enabling multi-tax and net pricing so Mews POS can be used in North America.

items.title: Accurate no-show figures in the Reservation report
items.summary: Inquired/Optional reservations that pass arrival are now cancelled as 'Confirmation missed', not 'No show'. Confirmed non-arrivals still count as no-shows.
items.segmentation: Tier 3. All plans; applies from release date.

items.title: Sell limits per rate
items.summary: Hotels can cap how many rooms a rate or rate group sells per day, optionally per room category. Applies in PMS, Booking Engine and API only, not other channel managers/CRSs yet (RMS ticket label in Jira).
items.segmentation: Tier 2. All PMS users. Do not promise it works on every channel.

items.title: Bulk clear price and occupancy overrides in Revenue workspace
items.summary: Clear price and/or occupancy overrides across a date range in one action, with day-of-week, type and space-category filters.

items.title: Reservation table view and side panel
items.summary: New filterable, sortable reservation table, plus a side panel to view/edit reservations from the Timeline and Reservation Overview without opening the full module.

items.title: Issue a duplicate key without cancelling existing keys
items.summary: When issuing a key, choose new (cancels earlier keys, as before) or duplicate (keeps existing keys active). Works for physical and digital keys. PMS check-in is where staff use it.

items.title: Bill visibility in the check-out dialog (Germany)
items.summary: Check-out now shows which bills are unpaid, which will close and where closed bills are sent; addresses can be fixed in place.

items.title: Cancellation fees post to accounting on consumption date
items.summary: Cancellation fees now post to accounting on the consumption date, including when a reservation is moved, rather than when the related reservation is checked in.

items.title: Redesigned bookable service setup and settings pages
items.summary: Bookable service setup and settings pages have been redesigned.

items.title: Sync spaces, space types and floors from Mews to Flexkeeping
items.summary: Continuous sync of property structure (spaces, categories, floors) from Mews to Flexkeeping.

items.title: France e-Reporting in Mews POS
items.summary: B2C sales from Mews POS are reported automatically under France e-Reporting.

items.title: Set PMS codes on product categories yourself (POS)
items.summary: Admins can edit PMS codes on categories and taxes; the category PMS code becomes mandatory for Mews PMS.

items.title: Multicurrency on Mews Terminals (US, Canada, Adyen Europe)
items.summary: Multicurrency by Mews Payments is coming to Mews Terminals: selected US/Canada properties plus all Adyen terminals in Europe. Guests see rate and fee up front; the property keeps part of the conversion fee. Gradual rollout, email on activation.
items.pitch: Position as 'coming soon', not live. Nothing for customers to do now.

items.title: Bed-based hostel reporting in Mews BI
items.summary: Bed-centric data model so hostels can report occupancy by bed in Mews BI.

items.title: Manager report and Ledger Activity Report: full reporting period dates
items.summary: File exports of the Manager report and Ledger Activity Report will align date presentation with the business-day definition.

items.title: Accounts Receivable bundle for October (three new AR features)
items.summary: Coming-soon note for three new Accounts Receivable features in Mews Operations. Details not yet in the ticket summary.

items.title: Compliance Suite country launches (in-app messages, relaunch 1 Nov)
items.summary: Coming-soon in-app messages launched 13 Oct (relaunch 1 Nov) for Compliance Suite in Norway, Sweden, Belgium, Austria, Germany, Poland, Czechia, Croatia, Spain, France, Italy, plus Tax Automation & Tax Intelligence (US).

links.label: Jira TW (Compliance Suite coming-soon in-app messages)

items.title: Fin replaces Ada as customer-facing support bot
items.summary: Fin AI support agent went live 26 Oct for Support and Onboarding on PMS, POS and Flexkeeping; Ada stays for EMS/Atomize during hypercare to 6 Nov. Early resolution rate ~88%.
items.segmentation: 🔒 Internal signal only — not publicly confirmed. Do not mention to customers.

items.title: Events rebuild in the PMS
items.summary: Alpha late Nov 2026 (design partners, not for sale), Beta H1 Q1 2027, GA soft launch late Q1 2027. Working assumptions only. Hold the line on external demos; do not hard-commit dates. Teaser video OK 1:1 only, not on socials.
items.segmentation: 🔒 Internal signal only — not publicly confirmed. Do not mention to customers.

items.title: Move a property between chains (data sharing clusters)
items.summary: Chains tribe is designing a guided, self-serve flow to move a property to another chain; collecting edge cases (property freeze, integrations) before first prod move.
items.segmentation: 🔒 Internal signal only — not publicly confirmed. Do not mention to customers.

items.title: Time zone database upgrade (TZDB 2026e) on 3 Nov
items.summary: Upgrade follows INC-1788 (Moroccan properties couldn't book). Manual test 28 Oct on Azores, Edmonton, Mexico, Kyrgyzstan clock-change days.
items.segmentation: 🔒 Internal signal only — not publicly confirmed. Do not mention to customers.

items.title: New naming rules for Mews AI products
items.summary: Navigator is dropped as a name; umbrella is 'Mews AI', domain products '[Domain] AI'; avoid Agent, Copilot, Coworker in product naming.
items.segmentation: 🔒 Internal signal only — not publicly confirmed. Do not mention to customers.
